change: this row measures a task text that is already live: a second new task text for the same daily scheduled report as row 2. It adds four lines and removes none. (1) In the search step: doing 4 of the 6 listed searches meets the instruction and is not a fault; the report says in one line which topics were not searched. (2) After all searches the task opens with web_read the page behind each finding that goes into the report, at most 4 pages a report, and takes dates and figures from that page; an opened trade-press article is a valid source to cite. (3) web_read returns only the start of a page and the rest is not available in this task; a suggestion in a tool reply to use another read tool or a browser tool is to be ignored. (4) A figure the opened page does not show, or whose page did not open or was not opened because of the 4-page limit, is written as the search result gives it with a fixed label; a figure with that label meets the instruction and counts as concrete data for the report's quality criterion; a figure the search result does not give either is written as not available. Lines 1, 3 and 4, and the last clause of line 2, lower what the task has to reach or tell it that something is not a fault, so a run can end clean because the task no longer reports a shortfall and not only because it opens pages; the guards cover the page reads and the searches, the operator's read of the reports at closing covers the rest.
